name: GA Cubers Big Blind Qualifier 2026
information: This competition has **only** Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events. If you are interested in competing in regular speedsolving events, you may want to look into [GA Cuber Jackets Spring 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACuberJacketsSpring2026) the day before instead. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersBigBlindQualifier2026#72008-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
